epistemic_standards.universal_theorems: Requires exact symbolic proof across all register and memory coordinates. Pure-register theorems are defined over modular states in Z/4093Z; raw integer scalar domains require explicit modular reduction on register writes.
epistemic_standards.empirical_retractions: Survives 1,000 unconstrained random trials + 64 adversarial aliasing sweeps under declared contract.
epistemic_standards.refuted_candidates: Fails on at least one admissible state configuration with explicit minimal counterexample.

Admissible only when memory addresses do not alias mod 64 (refuted on general state)
catalog.refutation_rationale: Reads memory (OP_MEM_LOOKUP) prior to writing memory (OP_MEM_STORE). When read address S_j and write address S_k alias mod 64 (S_j = S_k mod 64), step 1 reads the pre-existing cell value before overwriting it with S_k. Step 2 then reads the newly written S_k, producing a strict state divergence S'' != S'.
